display_name: The White House Rose Garden Murloc Incident
summary: At 03:14 AM, security cameras in the White House Rose Garden recorded a roughly 60 cm tall blue amphibious creature, visually identical to the 'murloc baby' low-level mob from the video game World of Warcraft. The Secret Service attempted to apply the standard 'unidentified animal intrusion' protocol, but no clause in the internal handbook covered creatures of this kind. The creature wandered the rose beds for approximately 90 minutes, continually emitting 'mrrgglglglgl' vocalizations. A White House kitchen night-shift employee successfully lured it to a tool shed using a piece of roast chicken. At roughly the same time, a college town in the western United States (location not disclosed) reported a suspected lab 'temporospatial anomaly' event — federal agencies have not formally linked the two.
significance: Demo story. Demonstrates the dual-track narrative architecture: an absurd event, refracted through multiple media outlets with different framings, presents 'how the same reality gets assembled inside different narrative frames' — which is what NovelWeb is trying to make possible.
